Inference.hint: Download a model into this browser and read the image shown. The image is not sent anywhere. Results are drawn on the image as annotations and can be saved.
Inference.runViewHint: Reads only the area you are zoomed into. Run again on another area to add to the results.
Inference.image_unsupported: Cropped or rotated images are not supported yet.
Inference.image_fetch: Could not load the image. Its server may not allow other sites to read it (CORS).
Inference.image_emptyView: There is no image in the visible area.
Inference.image_tooLarge: The visible area is too large. Zoom in a little more and run again.
Inference.pointStart: Click on the image to outline
Inference.pointHint: Click on something in the image to trace its shape. Shift-click to add to the last shape, Alt (Option)-click to take away from it. Zoom in before clicking for finer shapes.
Inference.batchNothing: Every page already has a result
Inference.batchNoModel: Download a model in the Inference tab to run it on all pages from here.
